description:
Elevate Organizational Performance: Power the Cloud Platform Behind Our Products as our Next DevOps Engineer! 

 Ready to accelerate software delivery and shape cloud infrastructure using agentic AI? Trimble is looking for a proactive DevOps Engineer to build scalable Azure environments and automated CI/CD pipelines that empower global construction teams to deliver with confidence. 

 About Us: Trimble is empowering stakeholders through planning, design, construction and the entire asset lifecycle. The company’s innovative and connected ecosystem of solutions improves coordination and collaboration between teams, phases and processes. Automating work and transforming workflows, Trimble is enabling teams to deliver with confidence at every turn. For more information, visit: construction.trimble.com. 

 What Makes This Role Great: In this hands-on role, you will build and run the cloud platform and delivery pipelines that get our products into customers' hands quickly, securely, and reliably. You will leverage agentic AI tools to automate infrastructure and operations while taking real ownership of production systems alongside experienced engineers and architects. 

 Key Exciting Responsibilities: 
 Architect and maintain scalable Azure infrastructure using Terraform and Terraform Cloud, contributing to a shared library of reusable modules. 
 Build and optimize reusable GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows to test, scan, sign, and deploy containerized .NET services and React micro-frontends. 
 Deploy and manage Kubernetes workloads on AKS via Docker, Helm, and Argo CD to keep environments consistent and promotable. 
 Embed security and compliance directly into pipelines using Azure Key Vault, OIDC credentials, Snyk, Mend, and container image signing. 
 Leverage AI coding agents to draft and review infrastructure and pipeline code while building automated agentic workflows inside CI. 
 
 Essential Skills & Experience: 
 2+ years of hands-on experience in a DevOps, platform, SRE, or cloud infrastructure role. 
 Practical experience with Microsoft Azure, Terraform (remote state and modules), and CI/CD pipelines like GitHub Actions. 
 Strong understanding of Docker, Kubernetes fundamentals, Git workflows, and scripting in Bash, PowerShell, or Python. 
 Solid grasp of cloud security essentials, including IAM, secret management, network segmentation, and vulnerability scanning. 
 Experience using AI coding agents in daily workflows paired with a commitment to ethical AI principles and system ownership. 
 
 Bonus Points For: 
 Experience authoring Helm charts and managing GitOps deployments with Argo CD. 
 Familiarity with observability tools (New Relic, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) and DevSecOps tools (Snyk, Mend, cosign). 
 Operational exposure to MongoDB Atlas, Confluent Kafka, Azure Service Bus, .NET services, or React micro-frontends. 
 Cloud or infrastructure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-400, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate. 
 Logistics: 
 Location: Lake Oswego, OR (Please clarify: Remote, Hybrid, or In Office?) Travel Requirement: 0% 

 Why You'll Love Working With Us: At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow. 
 You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data-driven insights that reduce waste. 
 Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work. 
 Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering
